purpose: Agent-level A/B evaluation prompts; not evidence of skill effectiveness until executed.

cases.prompt: Build a management dashboard; make it attractive and usable.
expected_observable_behaviors: inspect actual framework/dependencies and reusable components
recommend concrete candidate and integration location
plan representative runnable page covering normal/loading/empty/error/long-content states
failure_signals: invent framework or library without repo inspection
require user to know component names before the agent can proceed

cases.prompt: Our existing dashboard works but looks crowded and inconsistent.
expected_observable_behaviors: inspect existing component system before replacing
identify concrete hierarchy, layout, responsiveness or visual-state causes
propose smallest verified change
failure_signals: demand an ADR for a low-risk style tweak

cases.prompt: Create-job API returns 200 with an id but database record is absent.
expected_observable_behaviors: define acceptance against API plus durable readback
reject verified when API-only success is offered
schedule negative evidence of failure

cases.area: Mocked UI disconnected from real backend
cases.prompt: The demo page shows task completion using a stub service; the real backend is not wired.
expected_observable_behaviors: explicitly record mocked scope
keep real integration pending
do not claim end-to-end completion
failure_signals: accept mock proof as real integration

cases.prompt: A query on an empty source should return [] legitimately.
expected_observable_behaviors: treat empty result as valid when oracle expects zero
do not use return [] as a blind defect rule
failure_signals: flag all empty outputs as errors

cases.prompt: A new WP has approved scenarios and planned tests, but its implementation has not started.
expected_observable_behaviors: allow READY when scope and acceptance plan are complete
leave test execution NOT_RUN
do not label VERIFIED
failure_signals: require past test PASS to become READY

cases.prompt: Builder says 140 tests pass for new handler, but all tests predate it and no current SHA or run locator is supplied.
expected_observable_behaviors: reject VERIFIED without per-case changed-behavior evidence
separate regression baseline from new behavior proof
request exact SHA, environment and run references
failure_signals: claim new handler verified solely because old tests are green

cases.prompt: Change the help text in a CLI flag and verify it prints correctly.
expected_observable_behaviors: choose minimal relevant verification
avoid UI, API, broad Brownfield gate and multi-review by default
failure_signals: create 15 engineering docs for minor help text

cases.prompt: A queue job returns accepted but the worker has not processed it.
expected_observable_behaviors: distinguish 202 accepted from persisted completed result
define failure/retry and state observation
keep completion unverified until actual processing

cases.prompt: A collector may keep 98 valid rows of 100, but the downstream certified admission rejects any malformed batch.
expected_observable_behaviors: map layer-specific atomicity and error statuses
produce negative oracle agreed by domain authority
ensure no false demand record from malformed admission
failure_signals: unify all layers to one vague partial success rule

cases.prompt: A merge event touches identity, graph edges, adjacency, search and checkpoints in a versioned projection.
expected_observable_behaviors: audit actual recompute capability before handler coding
define replay/concurrency/version-scoped assertions
execute whole-chain integration or keep scope partial
failure_signals: claim merge complete after updating only one projection
assume all green old database tests prove new merge behavior
